name: List editor content modules
description: Call this when you need the catalogue of drag-and-drop content blocks available inside the Brevo email/newsletter editor — either the built-in default blocks (Title, Text, and similar) or the account's saved custom modules — before composing or patching editor content. Pass showCollectionBlock / showNewProdBlock / showProductFeedBlock to include the product and collection block types; pass sortField, orderDir, offset and limit to page through saved custom modules instead. Use editor.open_newsletter_editor to launch the editor itself, and editor.list_fonts for the typography choices rather than this action.
preconditions: The user must be authenticated against the editor API for the account whose modules are being listed.

showCollectionBlock.description: Include collection blocks in the returned module list.

showNewProdBlock.description: Include the newer product block type in the returned module list.

showProductFeedBlock.description: Include product feed blocks in the returned module list.

sortField.description: Field used to order the returned modules. Observed value: created_at.

offset.description: Number of modules to skip before the returned page; 0 starts at the first module.

limit.description: Maximum number of modules to return in this page.

modules.description: The matching modules, or null when the account has none. Each entry describes one editor block.

name.description: Display name of the module, e.g. Title or Text.

content.description: The block definition the editor inserts, including its HTML content, responsive layout map, moduleName, title and type.

thumbnailUrl.description: Path to the icon shown for this module in the editor sidebar.

order.description: Sort position of the module within its sidebar section.

sidebarSection.description: Sidebar grouping the module appears under, e.g. block.

type.description: Module category, e.g. default for built-in blocks.

count.description: Total number of modules matching the query, used for paging.

customModuleHasBeenTried.description: Whether the account has previously tried creating a custom module.
